subject: [PATCH 1/2] nfsd: remove the nfsdcltrack usermodehelper tracking backend

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch removes the deprecated usermodehelper tracking backend in the NFS server, specifically the upcall to /sbin/nfsdcltrack. The legacy client tracking methods have been superseded by nfsdcld and never worked in containers. The patch also removes related module parameters and code from the nfs4recover.c file.
